course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Numbers, dates, and strings: calculate values, format the result
goal: Distinguish value, string, and unit; independently calculate a midnight transition and verify preservation of the original type.

prerequisites.text: Complete Value types, Conditions, and Loops. Know how to preserve separate source versions and run a complete handler in your training infobase.

sections.title: Three different questions about one output
paragraphs: The string12.50 looks like a number, and09:31 looks like a time. A program must still distinguish the stored value, its presentation to a person, and the units used in a calculation. One question cannot substitute for another.

We will format12.5 into a separate string and add60 seconds to a specified date. The independent work is different: cross midnight with new inputs, produce210 seconds, and show that formatting did not replace the original number with a string.

sections.title: Value, presentation, and unit
paragraphs: Стоимость contains the number12.5. Формат creates its string presentation12.50, saved in another variable. An added zero in the string neither increases the original number's precision nor changes its type.

The name Стоимость does not define a currency or rounding policy; here it is a training quantity. Calculate with numbers and format a string for display afterward. Separately label the unit added to a date: seconds.

flow.caption: A quantity does not turn into a string by itself
flow.textLabel: Value and type transitions in text
alternative: Формат returns a separate string12.50, assigned to Представление.
There was no assignment to Стоимость, which still contains the number12.5.

sections.title: The complete example and its two messages
paragraphs: First, the string12.50 is created and displayed. Начало then receives six explicit date components,60 is added, and Конец−Начало is displayed as the second message:60.
The messages have different meanings: the first is a formatted string; the second is a number of seconds. Being displayable does not make their types the same.

sections.title: Before revealing: fifteen minutes
paragraphs: Only the addition changes in the complete handler:15×60 replaces60. Predict both messages and the new time first. Do not interpret the first12.50 output as minutes; it is a separate number presentation.
Record why the factor60 belongs before addition to the date. Reveal the comparison after your own answer.

reveal.title: Compare your prediction
paragraphs: The messages are12.50 and900; the end is09:45:00. Number formatting was unchanged. Only the seconds added to the date changed.

sections.title: Parameters specify a particular string
paragraphs: In this call, ЧДЦ=2 sets two fractional digits, ЧРД=. selects a dot, and ЧГ=0 disables digit grouping. The result is the string12.50, not a new numeric value with a currency.

Formatting is not parsing unknown input. A string with another dot, comma, currency, or separator needs an explicit parsing rule. This call does not establish support for every regional monetary format.

sections.title: Date components remove a guessing step
paragraphs: Дата(2026,10,31,9,30,0) lists year, month, day, hour, minute, second. It specifies a valid calendar date and time, without an ambiguous01/02 string.
In this arithmetic, date+15 adds15 seconds, while date+15×60 adds15 minutes. Date subtraction returns seconds. Unit conversion must be explicit; a convenient variable name does not perform it.

sections.title: Check the change on a timeline
paragraphs: From09:30 to09:45 is15 minutes, or900 seconds. The diagram shows the same addition in two representations, helping reveal a unit error before comparing long strings.
If the time moves by only a few seconds, inspect the addition expression first. Date formatting can change a string's appearance, not convert15 seconds into15 minutes.

flow.caption: From the specified start to a new moment
alternative: The start uses explicit components:31 October2026,09:30:00.
Convert15 minutes to900 seconds before adding them to the date.
The end is09:45:00; the difference in this arithmetic is900 seconds.

sections.title: A space in the format is part of the exact rule
paragraphs: For complete date/time display, use Формат(Момент, "ДФ='dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss'"). Outer double quotes delimit the BSL string; inner single quotes delimit one ДФ value, including the space between date and time.

This is more than a cosmetic edit. In the training 1C, the version without inner quotes displayed0:02:00, while the selected explicit format displayed00:02:00 for the same moment. The date value was unchanged; compliance with the specified string presentation changed.

sections.title: The same characters can hide a lost type
paragraphs: In the independent task,7.5 must remain a number while7.50 is created separately as a string. Assigning Формат back to the original variable can still display7.50, but ТипЗнч of the original then reports Строка.

Check the observable property: the original variable's type after formatting. An attractive string alone is insufficient. Here, Number and String correspond to the actual Russian messages Число and Строка on this training installation.

tables.caption: What distinguishes correct and incorrect assignments

sections.title: New inputs: finish work after midnight
paragraphs: Start:30 November2026,23:58:30. Duration:3 minutes30 seconds. Independently obtain the new moment,210 seconds, and a separate presentation of the training number7.5 as7.50.

Display five messages in order: complete end, difference in seconds, number presentation, original number's type, presentation's type. Zero duration must leave the start unchanged. Practice provides separate TODO and reference materials.

sections.title: Midnight is a day boundary, not lost seconds
paragraphs: There are90 seconds until midnight. That leaves120 of210 seconds, producing1 December00:02:00. The clock hour is smaller, but the new moment is later than the start.
Compare the complete date/time and numeric difference. A90-second duration ends exactly at midnight; zero duration must not invent a transition to the next day.

flow.caption: Crossing midnight changes the date too
alternative: Of210 seconds,120 remain, which is another2 minutes.
The result is1 December00:02:00; displaying only the time is insufficient.
With zero duration, the start remains30 November23:58:30.

sections.title: Find the first difference, not the last attractive string
paragraphs: Adding3 and30 without converting minutes gives33 seconds and23:59:03, rather than210 seconds and00:02:00 the next day. Fix the unit expression before date addition instead of printing the desired end as a separate literal.
If the date and210 match but the original value's type is Строка, inspect the destination of Формат. If only the hour's leading zero differs, inspect the exact format string and inner quotes.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to read
paragraphs: In your training infobase, open the application module from the configuration root. The screenshot shows the complete worked12.5/60 handler. Save the new independent program separately, preserving a copy of previous work.
Keep one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler, save, update the infobase, and start the client. Distinguish the five messages by their roles;210 is not a count of minutes.

sections.title: Facts from the new run
paragraphs: The complete worked handler displayed12.50 and60. The separate complete independent handler displayed01.12.2026 00:02:00,210,7.50,Число,Строка. Zero duration, exact midnight, another transition, and two deliberate errors were also checked.
Save your source version, prediction, and actual messages. Someone else's matching run does not replace an explanation of correct seconds and preservation of the original number's type.

sections.title: Where the verified conclusion ends
paragraphs: The start and duration are explicit; we did not guess how to parse ambiguous01/02 or monetary1,234. Unknown text input first needs an unambiguous contract, the original string, and a way to report rejection.

This experiment checks the selected value arithmetic and presentation. It does not establish time zones, international exchange rules, real-payment rounding, or learner understanding. Later topics will define such contracts separately.

selfcheck.prompt: Replace60 seconds with15×60 in the worked example. What is the second message?
selfcheck.feedback: 15 minutes equals900 seconds; date subtraction returns seconds. Formatting of12.5 is unchanged.

selfcheck.prompt: What type does Формат(Стоимость, ...) return here?
selfcheck.feedback: It creates a representation without changing the original number.
Convert 15 minutes explicitly by multiplying by 60.

Yes: Строка is another name for a number

steps.title: Make your own prediction first
steps.where: Nexus → Practice → your separate draft and run note
steps.action: Before running, record the expected date, time, seconds, and both types. Make a separate zero-duration prediction.
steps.why: A prediction records the dependency you expect before you compare it with a fact.
steps.expected: Your expectations are recorded separately from the actual result.

steps.title: Open the correct location
steps.where: Own training infobase → Designer → configuration root → Открыть модуль приложения
steps.action: Save the previous training source separately. Open your own infobase's application module and keep one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler.
steps.why: Work must run in a known training infobase, with a saved copy of the previous source.
steps.expected: The correct module is open; the previous version is saved.

steps.title: Implement your own version
steps.action: Start with the TODO starter and complete it yourself. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your saved Nexus code.
steps.why: The independent program uses a new rule; the worked example does not solve it.
steps.expected: A complete independent handler has clear variables and one entry point.

steps.title: Check it in installed 1C
steps.action: Save the module, update the database configuration, and start your own client. Record actual messages for each control input and compare them with your prediction.
steps.why: Installed 1C executes BSL; Nexus stores a learning draft and a result note.
steps.expected: Each case has an exact input and an observed actual output.

steps.title: Record the result
steps.where: Result recording → your BSL file and Nexus → external-run note
steps.action: Save the source, a prediction/fact/explanation table, and one changed case of your own. If results differ, find the first diverging step.
steps.why: The same final line does not establish correctness of every step or understanding.
steps.expected: Code, facts, and your own explanation remain separately available; completion is a self-report.
